description: This file defines a validation rule class 'TimezoneOffset' used for verifying timezone offset values within a specific range. It is part of the OrangeHRM core API validation rules.

classes.name: TimezoneOffset
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given timezone offset is within the allowed range (-12.00 to 14.00).

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input numerical value falls within the range of valid timezone offsets.
